US Supreme Court Upholds Birthright Citizenship, Rejects Trump Order

The US Supreme Court has ruled against an executive order by former President Donald Trump that sought to restrict birthright citizenship. The court's decision upholds the long-standing practice of granting citizenship to individuals born on American soil, as established by the 14th Amendment. This ruling clarifies the legal status of birthright citizenship in the United States.
